summary: Pulsenmore Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited condensed financial statements, operating and financial review, and press release for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer, containing standard financial disclosures and a subsequent event note regarding a healthcare AI regulatory sandbox program. No special-situation transaction, corporate action, or abrupt management change is described. The filing is purely informational and does not trigger any event-driven investment analysis.
